# Le Tran Gia Huy (Huy Le) — Software Engineer

> Le Tran Gia Huy (also known as Huy Le) is a Software Engineer specializing in
> frontend and AI-native web development, based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
> He has 4+ years of experience building production-grade web platforms in
> React, Next.js (App Router, React Server Components, Streaming), and
> TypeScript across the healthcare, legal-tech, and enterprise-event domains.
> He is the primary developer on core Naver Care tools,
> owning work end-to-end from initial specification to production observability.
> His focus areas are scalable monorepo architecture, widely-adopted design
> systems, and pragmatic AI/LLM product features that earn their place in the
> product rather than serving only as demos.

## Site

This is Huy Le's personal portfolio — a single-page site at https://huyle.work.
Its sections are in-page anchors (not separate URLs): an intro/hero, an about
section, a mission statement, a "What I Do" capabilities overview, a
professional experience timeline, selected work, an "Off the clock" photo
gallery (an interactive WebGL globe), and contact.

- [Portfolio home](https://huyle.work): Hero, About, Capabilities ("What I Do"), Experience, selected Work, the "Off the clock" gallery, and Contact — all on one page.

## Professional experience

- **Naver Care** — Frontend Engineer, Naver Vietnam (2025 – Present). Core tools for Naver's AI symptom-triage product. Built the Symptom Editor Admin — a drag-and-drop authoring tool with path validation, a patient-preview simulation mode, and review-then-activate version history — plus the user-facing adaptive Symptom Checker serving public and hospital-partner flows in Korean and English. Stack: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, React Flow, Apollo GraphQL, Ant Design.
- **InjuryEx** — Frontend Engineer / Team Lead, PTN Global (2024 – 2025). A legal-tech and healthcare workflow platform coordinating patients, lawyers, doctors, and pharmacies. Bootstrapped from an empty repository into the team's blueprint: defined the frontend stack and conventions, led the team, and designed complex multi-party workflows including automated ANZ and Xero payments with SMS/email notifications. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI, Auth0, FastAPI.
- **Australian Epilepsy Project** — Frontend Engineer, PTN Global (Florey Institute) (2023 – 2024). A government-funded diagnostic-imaging platform for a national epilepsy-diagnosis network. Translated clinical requirements into production-grade React features and integrated OHIF for advanced medical-imaging visualization, with full unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage. Stack: React.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, OHIF, Material UI, AWS.
- **ETech** — Frontend Engineer, Skyblaze Studios (2022 – 2023). An enterprise conference and event-management platform used by Burger King, Herbalife, JSEA, and Switch Production. Implemented WebSocket-based real-time virtual meeting rooms with live global stats and a reusable Vue component library, plus web and React Native features. Stack: Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WebSocket, React Native, AWS.

## Skills & capabilities

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, React Native, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form, Ant Design, Material UI, React Flow, Storybook.
- **AI-Native:** AI symptom matching, AI-assisted authoring, LLM report briefings, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot.
- **Backend / APIs:** Node.js, Fastify, TypeBox, Orval, FastAPI, Python, REST, GraphQL, Apollo, Auth0, Turborepo.
- **Testing & Quality:** Vitest, Playwright, React Testing Library, MSW, SonarQube, Docker, AWS, Grafana.
